MOOVICUT AGENT GUIDE

PURPOSE
Moovicut prepares an editable storyboard and shot list. It does not generate video.

BROWSER AUTOMATION
The open studio page (`/studio`) exposes window.Shotboard (window.Moovicut is the same object). Use capabilities() to inspect supported actions and getProject() to read the current project. createProject({ premise, model }) creates a storyboard. updateShot(id, patch), reorderShot(id, direction) and deleteShot(id) edit the board. exportJSON() returns a portable project document. This is an in-page API. The public network API is separate and stateless.

DEFAULT BOARD
A new board is 5 scenes × 3 seconds (15s total) unless shots, duration, or scenes say otherwise. 30s is 10 × 3s. 60s is 20 × 3s. Step-by-step mode in /studio edits each scene. Agents pass the same controls to POST /api/v1/storyboard or the MCP tool plan_storyboard.

REMOTE API
POST /api/v1/storyboard accepts premise, model, shots, mode or sequenceMode, continuity, density, aspectRatio, genre, style, duration, compact, an optional scenes array, a scenario object or text, and input "prose". Scenario mode stores characters, places, and light once, resolves them in each generated prompt, packs 15–60s sequences, and warns from 6,000 characters (hard cap 8,000). Style families are anime, cinema, and documentary. A client prompt is kept unless overwritePrompt is true. A normal premise is not auto-detected. regenerateShot plus project rebuilds one shot and leaves the others unchanged. warnings is omitted when empty and never blocks the board. Every mode shares one film sheet, and switching modes keeps it. format "agent" returns shotboard.compact.v1. A browser library can export characters, places, and styles. model accepts grok, google, sora, kling, runway, luma, wan, or generic. A full response includes modelProfile with the cited sources. Veo accepts 4, 6, or 8 seconds and 16:9 or 9:16. Values the official page does not state are marked unverified. compact:true or ?compact=1 returns title, premise, model, aspectRatio, studioUrl, and shots of order, duration, and prompt. studioUrl is a /studio#board= link. The hash is not stored.
GET /openapi.json is the OpenAPI 3.1 document.
POST /mcp is stateless MCP (initialize, tools/list, tools/call). Tools: plan_storyboard, export_prompts, validate_storyboard. GET /mcp describes it. /.well-known/mcp.json is discovery.
GET /agents and /agents.md explain when to use each one.
No API key. 30 requests per minute per IP. No database. Premises are not stored.
Custom scenes example:
{"premise":"A lighthouse keeper races the dusk to repair a failing beacon.","model":"grok","scenes":[{"action":"Wide view of the lighthouse at dusk","duration":3,"camera":"Slow push-in","lighting":"Blue hour"},{"action":"Close on the keeper repairing the lens","duration":4,"notes":"Wind on the gallery"}]}

CLI
node cli/moovicut.mjs --premise "A lighthouse keeper races the dusk." --model google --output storyboard.json
node cli/moovicut.mjs --premise "A lighthouse keeper races the dusk." --model google --shots 4 --duration 3 --output storyboard.json
node cli/moovicut.mjs --input storyboard.json --export-prompts
The shotboard command runs the same program. Omitting --shots and --duration plans 5 scenes of 3 seconds.

DOCUMENT CONTRACT
The flat shotboard.v1 document includes id, title, premise, model/target_model, aspectRatio and shots. Each shot includes a stable id/shot_id, numeric order, framing, lens, camera, action, lighting, sound, continuity, duration/duration_seconds and prompt. Preserve user-edited prompt text when reordering. Validate imported documents. Do not send prompts to a model unless the person chooses to paste them.

LOCAL STORAGE
Projects are stored in the current browser. JSON export is the portable backup. The studio can save a shotboard.backup.v1 library of projects on this device and restore that file after it validates. Browser storage failures must be reported, never hidden behind a success message.

PRICE
The prompts work with Grok Imagine, Google, or any other AI image or video model. Grok Imagine and Google are prompt targets in the picker, not bundled generation. Planning, editing, and JSON export are free. There is no subscription. Optional tips open https://buymeacoffee.com/enzoc1977r in a new tab. Moovicut does not take payment itself.

LIMITS
No account, no cross-device sync, and no video rendering inside Moovicut. The site is in English.
